title: Singleton job guard with atomic heartbeat lease and TTL boundary
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might read the strict-greater-than comparison as an off-by-one that holds a lease too long. It is the stated boundary: a lease is stale only when older than the TTL, so at exactly TTL it remains held, which the check pins down on both sides of the boundary.
